name: Rohan Verma
role: Marketing Director at Apex Retail India
comment: We have been working with Nexus for the past year and have seen a 340% increase in revenue from SMS marketing campaigns alone. Their automated text sequences and segmentation deliver an unbelievable 98% open rate. The team is responsive, strategic, and truly dedicated to our brand's growth.

name: Sneha Kulkarni
comment: Nexus transformed our customer retention. Our flash sale SMS broadcasts consistently generate six figures in sales within hours of sending. Their compliance setup, creative copywriting, and 2-way conversational messaging have made SMS our highest-ROI revenue channel.

name: Vikram Malhotra
comment: Switching our SMS marketing to Nexus was the best decision we made this year. They built out automated abandoned checkout texts, VIP early access drops, and post-purchase follow-ups that recovered over ₹65 Lakhs in lost revenue in our first quarter.

name: Arjun Mehta
role: Director of Growth at FitGear India
comment: Nexus has been an exceptional SMS marketing partner. Their deep knowledge of carrier delivery, A/B testing, and personalized messaging has doubled our subscriber list while cutting unsubscribes in half. I highly recommend Nexus to any brand ready to scale.

name: Rajesh Gupta
role: Head of Digital at LuxeDirect Delhi
comment: Working with Nexus opened our eyes to the true power of conversational SMS. Customer reply rates are through the roof, and our loyalty program engagement has skyrocketed. Their team delivers outstanding strategy and execution week after week.

name: Ananya Deshmukh
comment: Nexus made an immediate impact on our bottom line. Their targeted SMS campaigns drove a 45% lift in repeat purchases and delivered a 28x return on ad spend. If you want serious results from SMS marketing, Nexus is the team to trust.
